shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,230p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' package.json
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '128,158p'
sed -n '1,180p' tsconfig.json
sed -n '1,180p' src/types/ai.ts
rg -n \"validateInput|compileSchema|inputSchema\" src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry*.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && git log --oneline -5 && git diff origin/main...HEAD -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,260p' && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"ToolRegistry|inputSchema|tool-round|malformed|executor\" .specify specs docs README.md CHANGELOG.md | head -240
sed -n '1,220p' src/shared/logger.ts
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "fix(tools): validate registered input schemas" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
